=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is Coach Charyl Teal's named photograph on The Aquatic Academy Meet Our Family page. Bill confirmed the dest. Decipher Red 60 FL Charyl Ann Perry grew up in Columbus, Ohio, moved to Houston/Pearland in 1997, studied computer engineering, ran a software store, and organized Rebel Gamer of Texas. The Aquatic Academy names Coach Charyl Teal, Computer Engineering Technology, Columbus swimming, and Pearland Aquatics. Charyl Teal is a member of the Star Wars CCG Facebook group. Married-name dest: the Decipher facts and later public facts agree. Display name alone is not enough. Personal email from the Decipher profile stays off the article. One File only. See [[:File:Charyl Ann Perry portrait.jpg]].
